entries.title: apple pie
entries.description:
1. mix 3 cups flour, 2 tbsp white sugar, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1¼ tsp salt
2. cut in 2 sticks cold unsalted butter and 3 tbsp solid coconut oil until coarse crumbs form
3. mix 1 tsp vanilla with 8 tbsp ice water; gradually add to dough until it holds together when squeezed (up to 2 tbsp additional water)
4. divide dough into two disks (55% bottom, 45% top), wrap and refrigerate for 30–40 minutes
5. peel, core and thinly slice 4 apples (Golden Delicious and red varieties)
6. toss apples with ¼ cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp white sugar, 1½ tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp salt, 1 tbsp + 1 tsp flour, 2 tsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp lime juice and 1½ tsp vanilla
7. let apples rest for 15–20 minutes to release their juices
8. brown 1 tbsp butter in a skillet, add apples and juices, and sauté for 4–6 minutes until slightly softened; cool completely
9. roll larger dough disk to approximately ⅛-inch thickness and line an 8½-inch pie pan
10. add cooled apple filling, distributing evenly
11. roll remaining dough for a full top crust or lattice, seal and crimp edges; cut 3–5 steam vents if using a full crust
12. brush with 1 beaten egg mixed with 1 tbsp milk and sprinkle with 1 tbsp white sugar and 1–2 tsp brown sugar
13. refrigerate assembled pie for 15 minutes before baking
14. bake at 425°F for 15–17 minutes, then reduce to 375°F for another 25–30 minutes until deeply golden and filling bubbles
15. cool for at least 2 hours before slicing to allow filling to set

entries.title: une tarte à la pâte sucrée
entries.description:
pastry tarts (pâte sucrée)
1. cream 180g unsalted butter, 110g powdered sugar and ½ tsp salt on low until smooth
2. whisk 65g (4) egg yolks, 26g (2 tbsp) water and optional vanilla; gradually mix into butter
3. slowly add 350g flour on low until dough forms clumps
4. wrap dough and refrigerate for 1 hour
5. roll chilled dough between parchment to ⅛-inch thickness
6. cut separate bottoms and side strips, slightly taller than the tart rings
7. line rings, prick bottoms with a fork and freeze for 30 minutes
8. trim edges and bake frozen at 350°F convection with rings on for 25–30 minutes until lightly golden
9. brush with egg wash and bake another 5 minutes until golden brown
10. cool completely before filling; store unfilled shells airtight at room temperature overnight if needed

chocolate ganache filling
1. finely chop 300g 70% dark chocolate into a bowl
2. heat 300g heavy cream, 2 tsp espresso powder, 1 tsp water and 1½ tsp vanilla bean paste until simmering
3. pour hot cream over chocolate and stir until smooth
4. mix in 45g softened unsalted butter until glossy
5. pour warm ganache into cooled tart shells
6. refrigerate for 30–40 minutes until set; bring to room temperature before adding meringue
swiss meringue
1. whisk 155g (about 6) egg whites with 300g sugar until foamy
2. place over a double boiler and whisk continuously until 160°F and sugar is fully dissolved
3. transfer to stand mixer and whip on high until thick, glossy and stiff peaks form
4. continue whipping until meringue cools to 68–77°F
5. pipe onto filled tarts and optionally toast with a kitchen torch

vanilla pastry cream
1. heat 530g whole milk with 52g sugar until steaming
2. whisk 80g (5–6) egg yolks with remaining 53g sugar, 35g cornstarch and 2g salt
3. gradually whisk ⅓ of hot milk into yolks, then return mixture to saucepan
4. cook over medium heat, whisking constantly until thick and bubbling; continue for 2 minutes
5. remove from heat and whisk in 15g vanilla bean paste and 45g cold unsalted butter
6. strain into shallow container, press plastic wrap directly onto surface and refrigerate at least 3 hours
7. whisk chilled cream until smooth before filling cooled tart shells
white chocolate moisture seal
1. melt 60g real white chocolate in 15-second microwave bursts, stirring until smooth (105–110°F maximum preferred)
2. mix in 1 tsp neutral oil to thin
3. brush a thin layer inside fully cooled tart shells
4. allow chocolate to set completely before adding wet fillings

entries.title: chicken katsu curry
entries.description:
1. thinly slice 2 onions and caramelize in 1 tbsp oil for 20–25 minutes
2. add 2 chopped carrots and cook for 4–5 minutes
3. add 3–4 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger; cook for 1 minute
4. add 2 cups beef stock and simmer for 15–20 minutes
5. dissolve 1 full pack of S&B Golden Curry (medium hot), blend until smooth and strain
6. halve 12 baby yellow potatoes and boil for 8–12 minutes
7. add potatoes, ¼–½ cup heavy cream and ½–1½ cups water to the curry until desired consistency
8. butterfly and flatten 2 chicken breasts
9. season with 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper
10. coat in ½ cup cornstarch, 2 beaten eggs and 2 cups panko breadcrumbs
11. fry at 350°F until golden and cooked through (165°F internally)
12. slice chicken and serve over steamed rice with curry and 2–3 chopped green onions

entries.title: chocoflan
entries.description:
1. heat 200 g sugar and ⅓ cup water until amber; pour into a greased bundt pan
2. combine 125 g flour, 30 g cocoa powder, 100 g white sugar, ½ tsp baking soda, ½ tsp baking powder and ¼ tsp salt
3. mix 57 g melted butter, 1 tbsp oil, 50 g brown sugar, 1 egg and 1 egg yolk
4. mix in 190 ml milk, 1 tsp vinegar and 1 tsp vanilla extract
5. fold in the dry ingredients and pour over the caramel
6. gently blend 1 can condensed milk (14 oz), 1 can evaporated milk (12 fl oz), 5 medium eggs, 2 tsp vanilla extract and ⅛ tsp salt
7. strain the custard and gently pour over the cake batter
8. cover with foil and bake in a hot water bath at 325°F for 75–100 minutes, until the custard reaches 175–180°F
9. let cool, refrigerate for 6–8 hours and invert onto a serving plate

entries.title: chocolate chip chunk cookies
entries.description:
1. brown 113 g salted butter and let cool slightly
2. mix in 60 g brown sugar and 45 g white sugar
3. mix in 1 medium egg and 1½ tsp vanilla extract
4. fold in 175 g flour and ½ tsp baking soda
5. fold in 45 g chocolate chips and 45 g chopped chocolate
6. refrigerate for 30–45 minutes
7. divide into 8 balls and flatten slightly
8. bake at 375°F for 12–15 minutes
9. cool on the baking sheet for 5–8 minutes, wire rack for 10 minutes
